resources.string: Silent progress for audio downloads that are still running
Alerts when an audio download finishes or fails
sXdc uses a notification to show download progress and tell you when a file is ready. Downloads still work without it — they just run silently in the background.
No link was found in the shared text.
Share the link again once this is sorted.
Access lost \u2014 choose the folder again
Android did not grant lasting access to that folder. Try another one.
Saved, but not yet passed to yt-dlp \u2014 wiring these into the download is a later change.
Something went wrong. Try sharing the link again.
Stopped: the download exceeded the system time limit for background transfers.
Download failed \u2014 check your connection and try again.
That video isn\'t available. It may be private, deleted, or region-locked.
sXdc can\'t download from that link. Try a direct video or track link.
That video is blocked in your region.
That video needs a sign-in \u2014 age-restricted, members-only or private.
Not enough free space to save the file.
The audio converter failed. Reinstalling sXdc usually fixes this.
The download finished but produced no audio file.
The download engine couldn\'t start. Reinstalling sXdc usually fixes this.
The downloaded file went missing before it could be saved to your folder.
Couldn\'t create the file in your download folder. Try choosing the folder again in Settings.
Couldn\'t save into your download folder. The download was kept, so you can retry.
